cards.back: Wk 4 (Sep); Jeûne fédéral follows in wk 5.

cards.back: After wk 16 of Y12; teaching resumes with exponentials & logs (wk 17, Jan).

cards.front: How many labelled teaching blocks in Y12?
cards.back: 8 — prior learning, functions & quadratics, differentiation, circular trig, exp & logs, trig equations & functions, further differentiation, integration (first pass).

cards.front: How many labelled teaching blocks in Y13?
cards.back: 4 — integration continued, sequences & binomial, probability, statistics.

cards.front: Revision windows across the two years — how many?
cards.back: 4 — wk 18 (Jan) · wk 31 (May) · wks 16–18 (Jan, with mocks) · wks 23–24+ (Mar).

cards.front: Y12 exam windows — how many, and which weeks?
cards.back: 2 windows — wk 19 (Jan) and wks 32–34 (May–Jun).

cards.front: IA first draft to IA deadline — how long?
cards.back: 6 weeks — wk 9 (Nov) to wk 15 (Dec), with probability (wks 11–12) in between.

cards.front: IA deadline to mocks — how much slack?
cards.back: None — the revision + mock block (wks 16–18) starts the week after the wk 15 deadline.

cards.front: Mocks end to Statistics starts — any gap?
cards.back: Back-to-back — mocks wks 16–18, statistics wks 19–20.

cards.front: The one block that spans the summer break?
cards.back: Integration — first pass wks 36–37 (Jun, Y12) → continued wk 1 (Sep, Y13).
